title: FIBA: 'Always ready' Troy Rosario cuts family trip short to answer Gilas call
summary: Troy Rosario's inclusion in the Gilas Pilipinas roster for the fifth window of the FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers proves that the veteran is always ready to answer the call of the national team.
